headerDisplay: For help and support please visit our GitHub Wiki. We hope you find this plugin useful!

username.title: Govee Email
username.description: Required for most device models and for AWS/BLE connections. Read more →

password.title: Govee Password
password.description: Required for certain light models. Read more →

code.title: Govee 2FA Code
code.description: The first time the plugin tries to login, it might send a code to your email address. The code is valid for 15 minutes. Read more →

apiKey.title: Govee OpenAPI Key
apiKey.description: Optional. Used for Govee OpenAPI discovery/state/control when available. This is separate from the app login used for AWS/BLE connections.

ignoreMatter.title: Ignore Matter Devices
ignoreMatter.description: If enabled, the plugin will not set up Matter-enabled models.

httpRefreshTime.title: HTTP Refresh Interval
httpRefreshTime.description: An interval (in seconds) in which your HTTP devices will refresh with the plugin. Must be 30 or more.

awsDisable.title: Disable AWS
awsDisable.description: If enabled, the plugin will not set up AWS discovery and control.

bleDisable.title: Disable BLE
bleDisable.description: If enabled, the plugin will not set up BLE discovery and control.

bleRefreshTime.title: BLE Refresh Interval
bleRefreshTime.description: An interval (in seconds) in which your BLE devices will refresh with the plugin. Must be 60 or more.

lanDisable.title: Disable LAN
lanDisable.description: If enabled, the plugin will not set up LAN discovery and control.

lanRefreshTime.title: LAN Refresh Interval
lanRefreshTime.description: An interval (in seconds) in which your LAN devices will refresh with the plugin. Must be 10 or more.

lanScanInterval.title: LAN Scan Interval
lanScanInterval.description: An interval (in seconds) in which a the plugin will scan your network for devices. Must be 30 or more.

lanScanSubnets.title: LAN Scan Subnets
lanScanSubnets.description: Optional. Only needed if your Govee devices are on a different subnet/VLAN from Homebridge. LAN discovery normally uses multicast, which routers do not pass between subnets. Enter one or more subnets in CIDR form (e.g. 192.168.20.0/24), separated by commas, and the plugin will also scan those directly. Requires the devices to have LAN control enabled.

openApiDisable.title: Disable OpenAPI
openApiDisable.description: If enabled, the plugin will not set up OpenAPI discovery and control.

openApiRefreshTime.title: OpenAPI Refresh Interval
openApiRefreshTime.description: An interval (in seconds) in which your OpenAPI devices will refresh with the plugin. Must be 30 or more. Only applies to devices without an active AWS connection.

bleControlInterval.title: BLE Control Interval
bleControlInterval.description: A minimum delay (in seconds) between device updates being sent. Increasing this may help if you find device updates are not working or if you use HomeKit scenes/groupings. Must be 5 or more.

colourSafeMode.title: Colour Safe Mode
colourSafeMode.description: If true then the plugin will not add colour temperature characteristic to lights.

disableDeviceLogging.title: Disable Device Logging
disableDeviceLogging.description: Global logging setting for accessory status changes. If true then accessory status changes will not be logged. This can also be set per accessory later in the config.

lightDevices.title: Light Devices
lightDevices.description: Optional settings for Govee Light devices.

label.title: Label
label.description: This setting is only used for naming LAN-only accessories and config identification.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Enter the 23 digit Govee Device ID to begin (e.g. 12:AB:A1:C5:A8:99:D2:17).

ignoreDevice.title: Hide From HomeKit
ignoreDevice.description: If true, this accessory will be removed and ignored from HomeKit.

customAddress.title: Custom Bluetooth Address
customAddress.description: The plugin may not be able to determine the bluetooth address of some older models. Read more →

customIPAddress.title: Custom IP Address
customIPAddress.description: A fixed IP address for LAN mode, if the plugin cannot auto-discover this device.

brightnessStep.title: Brightness Step
brightnessStep.description: A minimum step for the brightness slider in the Home app. Must be 1 or more.

awsBrightnessScale.title: AWS Brightness Scale To 254
awsBrightnessScale.description: Only for a light that reaches full brightness at about 39% in Home: it counts to 254 over AWS rather than 100, so tick this to scale the value.

awsBrightnessNoScale.title: AWS Brightness No Scale
awsBrightnessNoScale.description: Only for a light the plugin scales to 254 by default but which drops to a few percent at full: tick this to send 0-100 as is.

adaptiveLightingShift.title: Adaptive Lighting Shift
adaptiveLightingShift.description: The mired for each Adaptive Lighting update will be increased by this value, making the light appear warmer. Set to -1 to remove Adaptive Lighting feature. Must be -1 or more.

sceneCode.description: Enter a scene code from the logs to create a button named 'Scene' (in Eve app).

bleCode.description: Can be (1) left blank, (2) used instead of, or (3) used along with the above AWS code. In the case of (3) please make sure both codes correspond to the same Govee mode.

sceneSelector.title: Scene Selector: Scenes
sceneSelector.description: Offer this device's preset scenes in a scene selector dropdown - a separate TV-style accessory added to HomeKit manually using the bridge's setup code. The accessory appears when any Scene Selector option is enabled. Needs a Govee API key.

sceneSelectorSnapshots.title: Scene Selector: Snapshots
sceneSelectorSnapshots.description: Offer this device's snapshots in the scene selector dropdown - can be enabled on its own, without the preset scenes.

sceneSelectorDiy.title: Scene Selector: DIY Scenes
sceneSelectorDiy.description: Offer this device's diy scenes in the scene selector dropdown - can be enabled on its own, without the preset scenes.

openApiTempUnit.title: OpenAPI Temperature Unit
openApiTempUnit.description: Govee's OpenAPI reports the temperature in whatever unit your Govee app is set to, without saying which. Leave this on Auto and the plugin will work it out. Only set it manually if the reported temperature is wrong.

showExtraSwitch.title: Show Extra Switch
